 St. Francis House launches chamber fundraising campaign for major expansion 
 Pigeon605 Staff
 November 4, 2026
 News 
 An effort to support building a $10 million addition to the St. Francis House officially kicked off today.
 The “Healing Home” fundraising campaign aims to raise $1.5 million of that total through the Greater Sioux Falls Chamber of Commerce Community Appeals program.
 It would add 38 efficiency units and dedicated space for community partners to provide on-site behavioral health services, substance-use recovery programs, healthcare, employment assistance, financial counseling and cultural support.
 The Healing Home Campus also would add the community’s first Donation Depot, which would facilitate an easy, accessible way to donate goods to St. Francis House and its partner nonprofits.
 Ben Dold, president and chief operating officer of Midco, and Mark Millage, director of community relations at Furniture Mart USA, are co-chairing the effort with more than 60 volunteers.
 “The Healing Home Campus is built around responsible stewardship,” Dold said in a statement. “We are bringing partner agencies together, allowing each organization to contribute its expertise while sharing programming, resources and in-kind donations.”
 St. Francis House has helped thousands in Sioux Falls escape from being homeless in its 40-year history.
 In expanding, “the greatest reward will not be the buildings we construct,” Millage said. “It will be seeing people heal, families reconnect, individuals return to the workforce and people who once experienced homelessness or incarceration become stable and contributing members of our community.”
 The campaign volunteers will begin making calls and setting up meetings with local businesses in the coming weeks.
 St. Francis House launches campaign to build Healing Home Campus
